Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details below and attachments.

1) EU-only processing: yes — we offer an EU-only processing profile for hosted accounts that pins compute, storage, and backups to EU regions. We also offer Private (VPC) deployment for customers who require additional isolation.

2) SCCs / DPA: attached is our current DPA (RDW_DPA_v3.pdf) and a short SCCs extract (SCCs-extract.txt). Kimberly is copied for legal-level questions and any non-negotiable clauses. We typically accept standard SCCs with the addition of the Data Processing Addendum.

3) Retention & deletion: customers can set retention at the project or route level. Deletion requests trigger asynchronous workflows; we provide a signed deletion confirmation and an audit entry with timestamp and job id. We keep a 30-day tombstone period by default (configurable).

4) Keys & metadata: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) in EU regions via KMS integrations; metadata routing is part of the EU-only profile and does not leave EU unless explicitly permitted in config.

5) Regional outages / fallback: by default requests are routed to EU regions only. We can configure strict-routing (fail closed) or permissive fallbacks (route to nearest compatible region). For EU-only legal commitments we recommend fail-closed. If you'd like, we can add an SLA clause that restricts cross-border fallback for your account.

Next steps: 1) Kimberly to review SCC redlines, 2) Technical note/playbook for EU-only routing (Marissa to provide), 3) If acceptable, we'll add EU-only routing to the contract and prepare DocuSign.

Attaching: RDW_DPA_v3.pdf, SCCs-extract.txt

Subject: Re: Follow-up: SCCs + backups question — technical details

Hi Mathieu / Anna — thanks, attaching a short "EU processing playbook" that walks through routing, backups, and logs. High-level answers below: 

- Backups: snapshot backups for hosted accounts configured with EU-only profile are stored in EU regions (we currently support frankfurt, amsterdam, and paris for EU pinning). Cross-region replication to non-EU locations is not enabled for EU-only accounts. For Dedicated/Private we can guarantee no off-EU replication.

- Snapshots & durability: we keep region-local snapshots for 14 days by default; longer retention can be provisioned in contract. Cold-archive exports are also EU-local when requested.

- Operational metadata: request logs, billing metadata, and telemetry for EU-only profiles are retained in EU storage and are accessible via the Console. Retention windows are configurable; default is 90 days for logs.

- Failover behavior: default EU-only routing = fail-closed. In rare catastrophic failures you can choose permissive fallback (route to another region) but we will not enable that for your tenant without written approval. We can add an SLA appendix that defines notification timelines (T+2 hours) and rollback requirements.

- Subprocessors: list in the DPA; the only subprocessors with potential non-EU processing are analytics vendors (opt-in). We support blocking any third-party processing by default for EU-only accounts.

I've attached eu_processing_playbook.pdf (high-level architecture + configuration steps) and included a short checklist for procurement.

- Rishi: prepare a proposed SLA appendix for EU-only routing + notification.
- Anna/Mathieu: confirm whether BYOK is required for the procurement package.
